excerpts.claim_supported: Existing Session identity wins before applying new creation fields.
Concurrent creation adopts the recorded Session; post-create hooks cannot undo it.
Prompt hooks occur before admission; an already durable message skips re-asking and leaves retry reconciliation to admission.
Historical prompt reconciliation needs the original durable Prompted event for delivery and verifies all projection identity before inserting a promoted inbox row.
Steers use the admission cutoff and sequence order; queue promotion takes one oldest pending row.
Prompted promotes and writes visible projection; PromptAdmitted only projects admission under the event machinery.
The drain resolves the stored Session and routes through its concrete Location.
Stop targets the exact process-local entry and clears pendingWake; it is not a durable cluster lease.
Stored placement and governance precede promotion; agent and Session rules are materialized; missing context is initialized before input visibility and new input resets the step allowance.
History follows baselineSeq; the final provider step advertises no tools; hosted engine history bypasses the Core provider compaction transform.
Interrupting a drain cancels all of that Session’s pending permission and question requests.
An unknown nonempty database is refused; fresh schema initialization uses an immediate transaction with a second existence check.
Unknown journal entries are refused; pending migrations first get VACUUM INTO backup and retention pruning.
Every pending migration rereads its identity inside an immediate write transaction before running and journaling it.
Database path, ordered migration identity and generated schema maintenance are user-data/maintenance contracts; history cannot be discarded.
Strict owner mismatch fails; exact replay identity is reconciled; conflicting replay and sequence gaps fail; ordinary foreign owner replay returns without applying.
Projectors, optional commit hook, sequence and sealed event insertion execute before the same immediate transaction closes.
The implementation explicitly refuses combining persist:false with a commit hook.
The durable stream subscribes to wakes before reading history and advances from stored durable events.
Scoped registrations reject duplicate keys; load sorts keys and provides the current turn only to load effects.
Configured project instructions must resolve inside the project while global inputs have distinct authority.
Escaped, missing discovered or missing configured instructions yield unavailable, not an empty/deleted context.
Model history is selected by compaction and baseline sequence predicates, rather than deleting prior transcript rows.
loadAll explicitly retains compacted history.
The exact default buffer, tail, tool-character and summary-output caps are constants.
The compaction LLM request has no tools; provider errors and text are collected before the successful-summary branch already shown in C018.
The composed default transform preserves messages and afterStep does nothing; alternate behavior requires replacement.
Canonical Tool.make decodes input and encodes/validates output, mapping violations to ToolFailure.
Tool.dynamic passes input undecoded to its external owner; local JSON Schema decoding must not be inferred.
Safety inspection precedes contextual bounding; Lean projection is selected only when generic bounding has not already retained a full file.
Scoped cleanup removes its own registrations, and latest local entries overlay process registrations during materialization.
Registry composition depends on safety/output, not PermissionV2; ordinary action/resource authorization remains a leaf boundary.
The generic bound limits contextual text but preserves structured output and media; managed paths remain observable.
Default contextual limits and retained-output lifetime are fixed constants.
Retention deletes only old tool_* files; capture/body state is not inferred from a model preview.
Rule evaluation is last-match with default ask.
Ordinary configured authorization resolves agent permissions, and configured deny precedes saved project allow; compare Session rules in the runner excerpt.
Bash permission precedes profile handling; read-only agents require confinement without fallback; confined background launches are refused.
Background launch preparation uses the same sandbox wrapper with its lifetime bound to the process.
Foreground execution wraps before agent-terminal launch; this is the actual order needed to interpret the older unsandboxed claim.
Environment scrub is limited to tool children and recognized patterns; discovery alone does not establish confinement.
Agent terminal is opt-in, excludes Windows/verbatim command paths and takes an already confined command.
Cipher implementation uses AES-256-GCM with a random 12-byte IV and auth tag.
OS keychain is preferred; fallback to a data-directory key file is explicitly weaker.
Memory inheritance is opt-in; legacy sealing failure preserves readability; undecodable rows are skipped and left untouched.
Current terminal instructions require the sandbox-before-PTY ordering and exact environment boundary.
Project documents are discovered once at Location opening and general settings apply global, direct, then .orchestra precedence; C032 supplies reverse policy order/global refresh.
Approve is parent-aware; revoke removes only the folder’s own entry, preserving any trusted parent.
Approval canonicalizes an existing absolute folder and refuses filesystem root.
Repository identity chooses remote, cache, then root commit; no repository returns the global project at filesystem root.
Physical resolution follows existing ancestors and bounded dangling symlinks; path authority is not just lexical normalization.
Checkpoint identity, exact retry and retained owner are checked before requiring the current Session; retries survive source Session deletion.
Reads bind project and digest; lists enforce the default and maximum page limits.
Fork writes copied projections with new message IDs and negative sequence positions, rather than replaying original side effects.
State rebuilds from initial plus ordered transforms, finalizes before commit, and serializes rebuild/read with a semaphore.
Plugin activation uses a child scope, publishes only after materialization, and closes/replays after failure.
Boot retry is collected flush followed by per-plugin reinstall after failure; this is not outer-batch durable atomicity.
Each ordinary MCP call asserts its namespaced permission and forwards cancellation and timeout to the SDK.
Stale asynchronous connection/catalog results close their client before registration; connected follows successful tools registration.
Generation invalidation prevents stale in-flight skill loading from refilling a new cache.
OAuth attempts are synchronized in-memory state owned by the Location layer; this map does not establish a durable resumable workflow.
The issued-frame symbol is private and the host boundary expressly does not prove persisted Session/tool-part existence.
Persisted validation rechecks placement, current root pending/running tool and the exact running child lineage.
Leaf construction/registration is Location-owned and lazy vendor I/O stays first-use; a failed noninterrupt startup sweep is logged.
The host binds scheduler process state and an absent binding defects explicitly.
Transport catalog/session bounds are documented by the native MCP owner; this is normative intent, not a newly observed implementation run.
Actions binding is obtained lazily on first operation and provider read adapters are explicit.
Prepare strictly decodes intent, verifies binding revision, reconciles exact retry and refuses capacity/unknown-outcome overflow before insertion.
Stale takeover checks exact prior ownership/claim and distinguishes admitted exact retry from void unadmitted dispatch.
Changing a decision updates standing lineage, while recording an outcome logs a stated reason rather than independently verifying work.
Dependency and host-floor checks precede acquisition; cross-target prefetch is not host execution.
Config can lower the owner byte caps, never raise them.
Status record writes are best effort; a failed rename/write can lose status and is not evidence of a successful build.
Research identity uses canonical object order, operation tuple and execution-scoped event ID.
Retained research events are filtered/decoded and scope/receipt mismatches are refused.
Composition types allow Location to depend on global nodes and preserve the converse boundary.
Collectors continue draining after byte caps; inspectors receive raw chunks; the process path receives optional RSS constraints.
Native collect is conditional on eligibility and other options route through the configured spawner; there is no universal captured-output bound.
Explicit native addon/supervisor paths must form an existing pair and do not silently borrow mismatched candidates.
The positive/strict control predicate is code, not an executed qualification result.
PTY exited retention and finalization cap are explicit; each subscriber has a pending array distinct from the retained output ring.
PTY finalization waits for pending stops only up to the configured cap.
Project LSP commands are admitted through ConfigTrust.
Workspace-code LSP commands take the confined branch; ordinary trusted commands have a distinct spawn path.
Formatter workspace code is confined with explicit write targets and exact child environment.
Log/tracing startup is conditional on an endpoint, not a claim of observed exporter availability.
The maintenance source explicitly preserves unresolved WebSocket-client backpressure/memory limits.
Native routes strip API keys from body settings; unknown explicit variants fail rather than silently changing selection.
The actual adapter branches accept a narrower API set than arbitrary SDK/catalog entries and return UnsupportedApiError otherwise.
The final request digest participates in sealed identity; admitted bound dimensions are mandatory and positive safe integers.
Occupancy uses settled usage or retained unsettled bounds and refuses/holds corrupt evidence; in-flight release is tracked independently.
Reservation persists body snapshot and distinct forward/terminal/usage/completion/semantic fields in its immediate transaction.
Move applies captured changes, then publishes Session.Moved, then discards source changes with a distinct later failure; no cross-filesystem/event rollback appears in this function.
The complete remainder of the assigned RAG SQL schema shows table/column scope and the deliberate chunk-orphan cleanup boundary; it cannot prove an engine or retrieval implementation.
The repository owner inventory places provider/vendor, utilities and data contracts under Core; this is navigation/ownership intent, not acceptance of every member.
The current repository instructions explicitly keep execution local and context ownership split across Core/domain/Session boundaries.
